top_signals.title: Russia Receives First Gasoline Cargo From India as Fuel Shortages Spread
top_signals.summary: Russia has received its first gasoline cargo from India as Ukrainian attacks knock out refining capacity and a second wave of fuel shortages spreads across at least 10 Russian regions, Reuters reported on Monday. The roughly 68,000-metric-ton cargo was produced by Nayara Energy at its Vadinar refinery in western India and delivered to Russia’s Arctic port of Vitino after a ship-to-ship transfer at Port Said, Egypt. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
